shadowSentences: The sun is shining brightly today.
I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn with its colors.
Cooking new recipes is a fun challenge for me.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
Traveling to new places expands my perspective on life.
I like to keep a journal to express my thoughts clearly.
Gardening teaches me patience and the value of hard work.
Volunteering in my community makes me feel fulfilled and happy.
Finding a balance between work and personal life is essential for well-being.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about hobbies.
questions: Q1: What hobbies do you enjoy and why?
Q2: Have you faced any challenges while pursuing your hobbies?
Q3: How do you think hobbies contribute to personal development?
Q4: What advice would you give someone looking to start a new hobby?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental protection.
questions: Q1: Can you share a personal experience related to environmental issues?
Q2: What challenges do people face when trying to protect the environment?
Q3: In your opinion, why is environmental protection important?
Q4: What actions can individuals take to help the environment?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about learning foreign languages.
questions: Q1: What language have you learned and what was your experience?
Q2: What difficulties did you encounter while learning this language?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of learning new languages?
Q4: What tips would you give to someone who wants to learn a foreign language?
